blocking_findings.statement: The function reserve_live_package_attempt takes registry_root from the caller, which violates the requirement that no public or indirect production input selects a safety-authoritative storage location. This enables an attacker to supply a different directory, bypassing the exclusivity check and allowing a second package attempt.

summary: The repository was verified at the exact candidate head and tree. Inspection reveals a single seeded defect: a caller-controlled production registry location in reserve_live_package_attempt. This violates claim S18-C-ROOT-001 and enables a second package attempt.
